name: asyntai
title: Asyntai AI Chatbot
description: Read your website chats, leads and support tickets, and ask your own AI chatbot a question, without opening the browser.
author: asyntai

commands.name: inbox
commands.title: Recent Chats
commands.subtitle: Asyntai
commands.description: The newest chats on your website. Open one to read the whole conversation.

commands.name: leads
commands.title: Leads
commands.subtitle: Asyntai
commands.description: Visitors who left an email address or a phone number in the chat.

commands.name: tickets
commands.title: Tickets
commands.subtitle: Asyntai
commands.description: Your support tickets, with the status and the visitor.

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Ask My Chatbot
commands.subtitle: Asyntai
commands.description: Ask your own AI chatbot a question and read the answer it gives your visitors.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API key
preferences.description: Your Asyntai API key. In Asyntai open Settings, then API, and copy the key.
preferences.placeholder: Paste the key from Settings, API

scripts.prepublishOnly: echo 'Use npm run publish to send the extension to the Raycast Store.' && exit 1
